name: The Lana Dubai
positioning: The Lana, a Dorchester Collection hotel on Marasi Drive in Business Bay, overlooking the Burj Khalifa and Marasi Bay Marina
best_for: Travelers who want Burj Khalifa views and a base near Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall
Food lovers interested in chef-led restaurants and cocktail bars under one roof
Spa-goers drawn to a Dior spa

facts.text: The Lana is located at Marasi Drive in Business Bay, Dubai.
The hotel overlooks the Burj Khalifa and is near Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall.
The hotel is approximately 20 minutes' drive from Dubai International Airport.
The Lana is part of Dorchester Collection and marks a new chapter for the brand in the Middle East.
All suites have private balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows.
The Panoramic Suite has views of Marasi Bay Marina, Downtown Dubai and the Burj Khalifa.
Spa treatments at Dior Spa The Lana draw inspiration from the Dior Prestige range.
The spa offers a Japanese-inspired massage ritual combining kneading, friction and percussive movements.
Riviera by Jean Imbert overlooks Marasi Bay Marina and serves modern Mediterranean cuisine.
Bonbon Cafe is pastry chef Angelo Musa's French patisserie beside the marina.
The Gallery is the hotel's social lounge and serves afternoon tea.
Bitter Honey mixes its own homemade syrups for its cocktails.

highlights.text: Riviera by Jean Imbert is the chef's first restaurant in the Middle East.
High Society sits at the very top of The Lana, with small plates, cocktails, live music and panoramic views over the Burj Khalifa.
The rooms and suites were designed by Gilles & Boissier, combining traditional elements with contemporary touches inspired by Dubai.
Bitter Honey is a cocktail bar with a tableside trolley service where cocktails are made to each guest's liking.
The hotel has Dior Spa The Lana with a gym, and an infinity pool on the rooftop.

considerations.text: Some dining closes seasonally: Veranda closes for the summer season, Jara closes in August, and the outdoor terraces at Jara and Riviera close for the summer months.
There are no electric vehicle charging ports at the hotel; the closest are at Dubai Mall.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the ultra-high-end positioning.
